_about.what: Generals: how they gain experience, what their skills and traits do, how they are lost, and who is on each nation's list.
_about.levelXp: Experience needed to go from each level to the next (index 1 is level 1 to 2). Every level brings one skill point.
_about.xp: Experience from one battle: for fighting it, for winning it, for a decisive or heroic win, for winning or holding against the odds, for holding at all, and for taking a capital.
_about.skills: Each point: offense adds this share to the corps' attack, defense to its defence. Logistics takes this share off the penalty of a long supply line and adds 'cutOff' to the half strength a cut-off corps fights at. Leadership takes 'steady' off the cohesion lost in battle and adds 'rally' to the cohesion regained each month.
_about.traits: attack and defence multiply the corps' strength; ap is extra weeks of movement a month; loss multiplies the corps' own losses; pocket multiplies attack against defenders with no line of retreat; winter is the share of the winter penalties still felt; xp multiplies experience gained. 'needs' is the record that earns it: [counter, count]. 'not' lists traits that rule it out. 'mobile' means it is only earned at the head of fast troops.
_about.counters: fast: decisive wins on the attack with fast troops. close: attacks won at pre-battle odds under closeOdds. enc: attacks won that ended with defenders surrendering. held: positions held against a stronger attacker. winter: battles fought on Soviet ground in winter without winter kit. costly: failed attacks that cost at least 'costly' of the corps. streak: defeats in a row.
_about.hazard: Chance a general is hit in a battle: base plus perLoss times the share of his corps lost. killedShare of those hits are fatal; the rest put him out for woundMonths. When his corps is destroyed or surrenders he is captured or killed with the chances under 'lost', and otherwise gets away.
_about.rise: A corps with no general that wins decisively or holds against the odds may throw up an officer who makes his name: chance per battle, while the nation has fewer generals than 'share' of its corps.
_about.sack: Sacking a general with at least 'popularLevel' levels or 'popularWins' wins costs his corps 'org' cohesion and the government 'pc' political capital.
_about.promote: Political capital it costs the player to promote an unknown officer to command a corps.
_about.ranks: What a general is called at each level: [from level, rank]. '_default' is used for a nation with no list of its own. A general who rises into a new rank is promoted, and the newsreel says so.
_about.legacy: How the three starting labels in setup-1939.json ('panzer', 'attacker', 'defender') become a general's level, skills and traits.
_about.roster: Generals who are not tied to a starting corps: [first month available, name, level, skills, traits]. They wait for a command; the computer gives them one.
_about.names: First names and family names for officers who rise from the ranks. These are invented people.

offense.label: Offense
offense.blurb: Each point adds 2% to his corps' attack.

defense.label: Defense
defense.blurb: Each point adds 2% to his corps' defence.

logistics.label: Logistics
logistics.blurb: Each point takes 5% off the penalty of a long supply line, and his corps fights better when cut off.

leadership.label: Leadership
leadership.blurb: Each point means 6% less cohesion lost in battle and 6% more regained each month.

panzer_leader.label: Panzer leader
panzer_leader.effect: Fast troops under him move an extra week every month and attack 6% harder.
panzer_leader.earned: Three decisive victories at the head of fast troops.

hard_charger.label: Hard charger
hard_charger.effect: Presses an attack home: 6% harder in attack.
hard_charger.earned: Three attacks won when the odds were close.

encirclement_master.label: Encirclement master
encirclement_master.effect: Attacks 15% harder against defenders who have no line of retreat.
encirclement_master.earned: Three victories that ended with the defenders laying down their arms.

iron_defender.label: Iron defender
iron_defender.effect: His corps is 6% stronger in defence.
iron_defender.earned: Three positions held against a stronger attacker.

winter_soldier.label: Winter soldier
winter_soldier.effect: His corps feels only half of a Russian winter in battle and in men lost to the cold, and the snow does not slow its march.
winter_soldier.earned: Three battles fought through a Russian winter without winter equipment.

rising_star.label: Rising star
rising_star.effect: Promoted from the ranks on merit. Learns 25% faster.
rising_star.earned: Made his name in battle, or was promoted over senior officers.

butcher.label: Butcher
butcher.effect: Attacks 5% harder, but his corps loses 25% more men doing it.
butcher.earned: Three failed assaults that cost his corps dearly.

cautious.label: Cautious
cautious.effect: Attacks 4% weaker, but breaks off sooner: his corps loses 15% fewer men.
